description: Exports data from geogrid elements to csv file. This command controls if and what values are included in the exported file. The values being exported by default are positions, stresses, stresses, and displacements.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Includes the position of structure elements

keywords.name: displacement
keywords.description: Includes the displacement vector at the centroid of structure elements

keywords.name: velocity
keywords.description: Includes the velocity vector at the centroid of structure elements

keywords.name: acceleration
keywords.description: Includes the acceleration vector at the centroid of structure elements

keywords.name: stress
keywords.description: Includes the stresses at the centroid of structure elements. Note that a stress recovery operation must be performed to get non-zero stresses. Use the commands structure geogrid recover surface and structure geogrid recover resultants .

keywords.name: location-index
keywords.description: Indicates where the stresses are computed: i = 0 corresponds to the element centroid, while i = 1 to 3 indicates the positions of the nodes with those local indices.

keywords.name: depth-factor
keywords.description: Specifies the depth factor at which stresses for elements with an elastic material model have been recovered.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Includes the group assignments to elements in the slot defined by keyword Slot

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Specifies the slot s in which the group name is exported. If not specified, slot Default is used.

notes: New in 9.8. Without filename the data goes to out.csv in the working directory.
3D only: FLAC2D has no structure geogrid.
